statements.statement: A browser keys cookies by name, domain and path. A cookie set with Path=/ and another with the same name set with Path=/account are two cookies, and a request to /account carries both, the longer path first. statements.sentence: username=%D5%C5%C8%FD 是按 GBK 编码的“张三”，不是 UTF-8。
statements.statement: username=%D5%C5%C8%FD 是按 GBK 编码的“张三”，不是 UTF-8，所以按原文显示并提示。按 UTF-8 编码时应为 %E5%BC%A0%E4%B8%89。
statements.qualification: GBK 张三 = D5 C5 C8 FD；UTF-8 = E5 BC A0 E4 B8 89。组件按 UTF-8 解码失败时保留原文。
